description.value:
Requirements You're in Stellar Dance Stance, and your dance isn't at its zenith.

Like the moon drawing the ocean up the shore, you can draw your foes into danger. Attempt a @Check[performance|against:reflex] check against the Reflex DC of a creature in reach.

Critical Success You Stride and move the target up to 10 feet in the direction of your movement. Your movement doesn't trigger reactions from the target. Your dance also reaches its zenith, and you can choose for the additional damage to be cold instead of force.

Success As critical success, but you move the target up to 5 feet in the direction of your movement.

Failure The target doesn't move. You can Stride if you choose, but your movement triggers reactions normally.

Critical Failure You misstep. You don't move, and you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] until the start of your next turn.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Panache] class feature and your [[/act perform]] actions gain the bravado trait, Figure of the Lunar Embrace gains the bravado trait.
